note: VFX Studio textures picked for the toon void ground explosion (reference: the reference video Styl_VoidRend_v2 (third-party, not included), frames f534-f595). All are white/greyscale on TRANSPARENCY (checked from the alpha channel: no opaque black, saturation 0), so they tint with Color and also work at LightEmission 0 for the dark layers. grid = flipbook grid (4 = Grid4x4, 8 = Grid8x8, null = single image); flipbooks only animate on ParticleEmitters (FlipbookLayout Grid<g>x<g>, FlipbookMode OneShot). Use as rbxassetid://<id>. The contact sheet tools/vfx/out/voidrend_picks.png shows these in file order (cell 0 = ImpactSplash ... cell 20 = CraterStar). Existing picks in vfx_studio_picks.json reused: Sparkle4 (Twinkle). Note: the old RingThin pick (101325137377720, Sun_Circle_Outer) is a decorated rune ring with spokes, not a clean shock ring; ShockRing below replaces it for this effect.

ImpactSplash.what: radial jagged toon spike burst that tears apart and fades, one-shot 4x4; camera-facing around the dome = the lilac spike silhouette of f566/f571

ImpactSplashAlt.what: side-view jagged spike splash rising from a ground line, one-shot 4x4; ring a few upright billboards around the dome base for the spike crown seen from the side

Shards.what: single jagged toon shard that thins to a needle over 16 frames, one-shot; Emit with high Drag + upward speed for the lilac pieces thrown up (f571-f578)

ShardsAlt.what: jagged splash blob shattering into flying pieces, one-shot 4x4; one big sprite for the dome breaking up

Smoke.what: two-tone grey toon puff that curls and swirls apart, one-shot 4x4; mid-grey body + lighter tops keep volume at LightEmission 0, tint indigo/navy for the dark-blue swirl smoke (f578-f595)

SmokeAlt.what: toon puff with a white inner highlight and mid-grey body that curls into a crescent, one-shot 4x4; also reads dark at LightEmission 0

SoftOrb.what: big near-flat white disc with a soft edge (bokeh look), single image; purple out-of-focus orbs drifting up (f595), high Transparency

SoftOrbAlt.what: softer gaussian blob, single image; hazier orbs or a ground glow under the disc

Twinkle.what: existing Sparkle4 pick, confirmed: crisp 4-point star at full size on frame 0 that shrinks and dissolves to dust, one-shot 8x8; matches the 'popped at full size' twinkles

TwinkleAlt.what: rounded toon 4-point star with soft glow that grows then shrinks, one-shot 4x4; softer, more cartoon twinkle

GroundSwirl.what: thick soft swirl ring with an open centre, single image; ground-flat decal/particle, slow spin, tint dark blue for the charge/cool-down ground ring (f545, f578)

GroundSwirlAlt.what: crisp brush-stroke swirl ring, single image; brighter inner swirl layer on top of GroundSwirl

BeamBody.what: soft vertical energy streaks with thin hairlines and soft side fall-off, single image; pillar body with TextureSpeed scroll (f545). Streaks run vertically in the image (AGENTS.md: a Beam runs the texture's height along its length)

BeamBodyAlt.what: bright white beam core with flowing streak lines, single image; narrow white core beam inside BeamBody

Lightning.what: thin jagged electric squiggle with small forks running top to bottom, single image; magenta squiggle up the pillar (f545), swap/offset every 2-3 frames

LightningAlt.what: two intertwined thin electric strands running top to bottom, single image; denser squiggle variant

CrownFlash.what: solid white spiky star burst with soft edges, single image; laid flat at the strike point and popped at full size = the white spiky crown of f534

CrownFlashAlt.what: ring of fine white spikes around a hollow centre, single image; flat 'star ring' version of the crown, or a spiky rim around the burst disc

ShockRing.what: clean thin ring with a soft glow that fills the frame, single image; ground-flat, scale up while fading for the cool-down ring (f578)

ShockRingAlt.what: toon ring that goes from a thick donut to a thin broken line, one-shot 4x4; particle version of the shock ring (grow Size while it plays)

CraterStar.what: extra (not one of the 10 roles): bold 10-point cartoon star outline, single image; tint black at LightEmission 0 on top of the magenta disc = the black spiky crater star (f566, day frame)
